critical_code_review_comments: TonerModelSearchSelect.jsx is clean and well-scoped (173 lines); good use of debounce (180ms), AbortController not used but stale-response risk is low because results setter only runs after latest debounce fires.

When onSelect is invoked from pickFromDb with an empty printers list (catch branch or 404), it correctly emits (model, []); the SupplierDashboard handler then keeps the previous compatibleModels value (because of the `printers.length > 0` guard) — correct UX.
deriveTonerModel slices to 50 chars — matches expected DB column width; consistent with single-upload submit() at line 551.
